title: 'Kitna hi khilao, pet bharta nahin'
text: Telling industry it had not shared the tax cut with workers, the PM said: 'aap ki bhookh itni hai, kitna hi khilao pet bharta nahin hai' (your appetite is such that it is never satisfied).
use: For 'Need brings greed, if greed increases it spoils breed' (2016).
